episodes.title: Part 1: The Inciting Spark
episodes.break_rationale: Ashley and her family relocate from Mundakkayam to Angamaly; her first glimpse of the parish church choir.
episodes.recap_text: Following financial distress, Ashley arrives in Angamaly leaving her old life behind.
episodes.teaser_next: Ashley attends her first Bethlehem Kudumba Unit prayer meeting and meets Justin.

episodes.title: Part 2: The Kudumba Unit Spark
episodes.break_rationale: Ashley joins Justin's choir session; instant chemistry sparks curiosity among unit elders.
episodes.recap_text: Justin introduces Ashley to the parish choir, igniting an immediate musical connection.
episodes.teaser_next: Secret late-night choir rehearsals and scooter rides begin to raise neighborhood eyebrows.

episodes.title: Part 3: Rhythms & Rumors
episodes.break_rationale: Justin and Ashley's secret romance deepens as they narrowly avoid nosy neighbors after practice.
episodes.recap_text: Banter and late-night rehearsals blossom into a secret romance across Angamaly.
episodes.teaser_next: The parish feast arrives as rumors threaten to reach Ashley's conservative family.

episodes.title: Part 4: The Parish Feast Confession
episodes.break_rationale: Justin confesses his genuine feelings before the feast just as family tensions reach a boiling point.
episodes.recap_text: Their performance at the feast captivates the parish, but family scrutiny intensifies.
episodes.teaser_next: An unexpected letter from Dublin arrives, threatening to alter Ashley's future.

episodes.title: Part 5: The Ireland Dilemma
episodes.break_rationale: Ashley receives her student visa for Ireland, sparking an agonizing dilemma between love and ambition.
episodes.recap_text: With family pressure mounting to secure her future in Dublin, Ashley is torn.
episodes.teaser_next: Justin makes a heartbreaking choice at the midnight tea stall.

episodes.title: Part 6: The Airport Farewell
episodes.break_rationale: Emotional farewell at Cochin airport as Justin selflessly encourages Ashley to board her Dublin flight.
episodes.recap_text: Justin chooses Ashley's dreams over his own heartbreak, waving goodbye at gate 4.
episodes.teaser_next: Eighteen months pass in Ireland; a wedding brings Ashley back to Kerala.

episodes.title: Part 7: Return to Angamaly
episodes.break_rationale: Ashley returns from Ireland for the neighbor's wedding and spots Justin across the church courtyard.
episodes.recap_text: Returning to Kerala after 18 months, Ashley discovers Justin waiting by the parish gate.
episodes.teaser_next: The wedding ceremony begins as Ashley and Justin confront unspoken feelings.

episodes.title: Part 8: Harmonies of Bethlehem
episodes.break_rationale: Grand finale: the full choir harmonizes at the ceremony, reuniting Ashley and Justin in triumph.
episodes.recap_text: Ashley and Justin reunite in a joyful, musical celebration at the parish hall.
episodes.teaser_next: Series finale concludes the 8-episode miniseries cut of Bethlehem Kudumba Unit!
